To assemble the CPAP device and tubing, follow these steps:

1. Place the device on a stable surface.
2. Plug the power connector into the rear of the device.
3. Connect the power cord to the power supply unit and a power outlet.
4. Connect the air tubing firmly to the air outlet at the rear of the device.
5. Fill the humidifier with water up to the maximum level mark.
6. Close the humidifier and insert it into the side of the device.
7. Connect the free end of the air tubing firmly onto the assembled mask.

Stop before fitting the mask to complete the assembly process.

To fit the mask to the mannequin, follow the instructions in the mask user guide. Check and ensure the mask fit is good by using the "Run Mask Fit" option on the CPAP device. Once the mask fit is satisfactory, start therapy by pressing the Start/Stop button on the CPAP device. Refer to the "My Options" section for detailed instructions on using the Check Mask Fit option and starting therapy.

To resolve dry nose during therapy, adjust the Humidity Level setting on your AirSense 10 device. In the "My Options" section, you can set the Humidity Level between 1 and 8, with 1 being the lowest and 8 being the highest humidity setting. Increase the humidity level if you are experiencing dry nose to make your therapy more comfortable. Refer to the manual section "My Options" for detailed instructions on adjusting the Humidity Level.
The AirSense 10 device itself should be cleaned weekly, as stated in the "Caring for Your Device" section of the user guide.
For “System fault, refer to user guide, Error 006”, this is treated as an Error 0XX case. Contact your care provider . Do not open the device.

To assemble the CPAP device and tubing, and connect the mask ready for first use, follow these steps:

1. Make sure the CPAP device is connected and turned on.
2. Hold the cuff of the air tubing and line up the air tubing connector with the connector port on the device.
3. Push the cuff until the connector clicks into place. "ClimateLineAir connected" will briefly display on the device screen.
4. Connect the assembled mask to the free end of the air tubing.

Stop before fitting the mask onto your face.

The ResMed ClimateLineAir user manual does not contain specific instructions for fitting the mask to a mannequin or using a "Check Mask Fit" option on the CPAP device. For detailed guidance on fitting the mask and checking the mask fit, please refer to the appropriate user guide provided with the CPAP device.

To resolve a dry nose during therapy, adjust the Humidity Level setting. Increase the Humidity Level if experiencing dryness. You can set the Humidity Level between 1 and 8, with 1 being the lowest and 8 the highest. To adjust the Humidity Level, go to My Options, highlight Humidity Level, adjust the setting, and save the change. (Source: Climate Control)
